summary: Implemented `Perc` in `seaborn._stats.order`, exported it through `seaborn.objects`, and added API documentation, examples, a v0.12.1 release note, and focused tests. The focused tests pass (6/6). The full suite reported 1,783 passed and one unrelated environment-sensitive failure in `tests/test_axisgrid.py::TestFacetGrid::test_subplot_kws` (Matplotlib returned `PolarAxes` where the test expects `PolarAxesSubplot`). No packages were installed and no changes were committed. I did not test the NumPy <1.22 compatibility branch in this environment.
